A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Normalize fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a subtraction-ready equivalent form, such as converting to an equivalent fraction, simplifying a fraction part, normalizing an improper mixed number, or expressing a whole number as whole plus fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step converts unlike-denominator fractions to equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a fraction part is simplified before subtraction.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag mere subtraction once forms are already aligned.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping from the whole part.
Do not tag final simplification of the answer after subtraction unless the step is explicitly a preparatory rewrite before subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed-number expressions once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators are already the same or made the same.
Tag when a step explicitly computes both whole-part and fraction-part differences.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or rewriting numbers.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps.
Do not tag combine-only steps that merely restate the computed result without performing subtraction.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative or insufficient.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is taken from the whole-number part and converted into denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when a negative fractional difference is resolved by regrouping.
Tag when the solver explicitly performs borrowing before completing the fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction that does not require regrouping.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as whole plus 0 over a denominator unless a later step actually borrows.
Do not tag final simplification or combining of the answer.

skills.name: Compose simplified result
skills.definition: Express the computed difference in valid final form by combining whole and fractional parts and simplifying to lowest terms or to an integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when whole and fraction parts are combined into a mixed number or a single final value.
Tag when a fractional result is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fraction is rewritten as 0 or an integer result is stated.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory simplification done before subtraction.
Do not tag subtraction or borrowing steps themselves.
Do not tag intermediate equivalent-fraction rewrites used only to align denominators.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into a subtraction-ready equivalent form, such as converting a mixed number with an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step rewrites a mixed number with an improper fraction part (for example, 2 3/2 to 3 1/2).
Tag when a step rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator (for example, 3 to 3 + 0/5).
Tag when a step explicitly decomposes a mixed number into whole and fraction parts to prepare for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag merely finding a common denominator without rewriting the overall operand structure.
Do not tag the actual subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts.
Do not tag final recombination or simplification unless the step is explicitly a preparatory rewrite.

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Create equivalent fractions with a common denominator when the fractional parts are not already directly subtractable.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.
Tag even if the denominators are already equal but the solver explicitly verifies or states the common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction of fractions that already share a denominator unless the step explicitly performs denominator matching.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as having a zero fractional part.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part.

skills.name: Subtract with regrouping
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction of whole and/or fractional parts, including borrowing one whole into fractional units when the fractional minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted for like-denominator fractions.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts are subtracted in mixed-number or whole-number contexts.
Tag when a step borrows or regroups one whole into fractional units to complete the subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory normalization steps that only rewrite operands.
Do not tag finding or creating common denominators.
Do not tag final simplification or combining unless subtraction/regrouping itself is performed in that step.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified to lowest terms.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is rewritten as 0 or a whole-plus-zero-fraction result is rewritten as an integer.
Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into a final mixed number or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself.
Do not tag denominator matching or operand normalization.
Do not tag intermediate unsimplified results unless the step explicitly reduces or formats the final answer.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, including converting mixed numbers with improper fraction parts and expressing whole numbers as whole plus fractional parts when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step converts a mixed number with an improper fraction part into a standard mixed number (for example, 2 3/2 to 3 1/2).
Tag when a step rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align parts for subtraction.
Tag when a step explicitly decomposes a mixed number into whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag merely finding a common denominator for two fractions.
Do not tag the actual subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts once the forms are already prepared.
Do not tag simplification of a final fraction unless it is part of rewriting the original operand before subtraction.

skills.name: Align fractional units
skills.definition: Express fractional parts with a common denominator or equivalent simplified form so they can be directly compared or subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step finds an LCD and converts fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.
Tag when a step simplifies a fraction part in a mixed number to an equivalent form that matches the other denominator.
Tag when a step explicitly notes that fraction parts are already in the same denominator and therefore aligned.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction of numerators after denominators are aligned.
Do not tag rewriting whole numbers as whole plus 0 over a denominator; that belongs to operand normalization.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part to fix a negative fractional difference.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole and fractional parts of mixed-number expressions once the quantities are in compatible forms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts numerators of fractions that already share a denominator.
Tag when a step subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in a mixed-number problem without borrowing.
Tag when a step combines the resulting whole and fractional parts into the stated answer form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is creating common denominators or equivalent forms.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used because the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 9/12 to 3/4 unless subtraction is also performed in that same step.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Borrow one whole into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would be negative, and reduce any resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into denominator-sized fractional units.
Tag when a step recomputes the fractional difference after borrowing.
Tag when a step simplifies a non-reduced result or converts a zero fraction such as 0/3 to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that do not require borrowing.
Do not tag initial normalization of operands before subtraction.
Do not tag finding a common denominator unless it is part of the borrowing-free alignment process.
